description: The Final Message to the Wildhammer Level 50 Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to travel to Aerie Peak in the western region of the Hinterlands and place the Final Message to the Wildhammer by the well in the center of town. Return to him once this task is complete. Beware of angry Wildhammer dwarves and unruly members of the Alliance. Requirements: - Message to the Wildhammer Delivered
name: The Final Message to the Wildhammer
